newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech says MCI Ill. local service pact cleared.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech says MCI Ill. local service pact cleared.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said the Illinois Commerce Commission approved a three-year agreement under which MCImetro Transmission Services Inc, a unit of MCI Communications Corp, may immediately begin providing competitive local telephone service in Ameritech-served areas of the state.

The agreement sets terms for direct interconnection by MCI with Ameritech's Illinois phone network and details how the companies will link networks, exchange phone calls and compensate each other, Ameritech said.

"It's been a long road, but we now have an agreement that gives MCI everything it needs to enter the local phone market in Illinois," said Neil Cox, president of Ameritech Information Industry Services.
